title: Fast, facile synthesis method for BAL-mediated PVP-bismuth nanoparticles
author: Vazquez-Munoz, Arellano-Jimenez, et al.

steps.title: Clean all glassware and equipment
steps.instruction: Wash the beaker, thermometer, pH‑meter, and stir bar thoroughly with distilled water and ensure they are completely clean before use.

steps.title: Prepare stock solutions
steps.instruction: Using Milli‑Q (or distilled) water, make the following stock solutions: 1 M glycine, 3 M NaOH, 3 mM PVP (dissolve 0.3 g PVP‑10 K (M = 10 000) in 10 mL water), and 1 M NaBH₄ (prepare fresh immediately before use because it loses activity quickly).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 0.3 g PVP‑10 K in 10 mL Milli‑Q water to obtain a 3 mM PVP solution.
Prepare 1 M glycine solution in water.
Prepare 3 M NaOH solution in water.
Just before the synthesis, dissolve NaBH₄ in water to a final concentration of 1 M.

steps.title: Assemble reaction mixture (single synthesis)
steps.instruction: In a clean beaker, combine the following volumes of the prepared stock solutions (or freshly prepared NaBH₄) in Milli‑Q (or distilled) water: 20 mL 1 M glycine, 5 mL 3 M NaOH, 5 mL 3 mM PVP, and 10 mL 1 M NaBH₄.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 mL of the 1 M glycine stock.
Add 5 mL of the 3 M NaOH stock.
Add 5 mL of the 3 mM PVP stock.
Add 10 mL of the freshly prepared 1 M NaBH₄ solution.

steps.title: Handle BAL and bismuth nitrate safely
steps.instruction: Use BAL and bismuth nitrate as received; open BAL inside a chemical hood, wear gloves, a mask, and any other appropriate personal protective equipment throughout the synthesis.

steps.title: Characterize nanoparticles by DLS
steps.instruction: Dilute the synthesized BiNPs in Milli‑Q water, transfer the diluted suspension to a DTS1070 cell, and measure the hydrodynamic size with a Zetasizer Nano ZS (Malvern Panalytical) at room temperature, performing three replicate measurements.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a dilute suspension of the BiNPs in Milli‑Q water.
Load the suspension into a DTS1070 cuvette.
Run DLS analysis on the Zetasizer Nano ZS at room temperature.
Record the size data from three independent measurements.

description: After the method was standardized, the BAL-mediated BiNPs were synthesized in more than 10 rounds, on different days, to verify the reproducibility of the protocol. The measurement of the BiNPs size was performed on randomly selected different rounds of synthesis, for the TEM and the DLS analysis. The statistical analysis was performed on the Prism 8 (GraphPad Software Inc) software.
